research_question: can clearly separated temporary q1/q2 intermediate posture regions reduce future total measured cuff-force integral under matched task timing

basis: existing task start and goal geometry
existing joint position velocity and acceleration limits
equal mean normalized progress across branches
fixed waypoint and phase timing budgets

feasibility_audit_history.reason: outbound hip and both knee regions were not reached; both knee branches violated the unchanged deployable acceleration monitor

all regions were reached, but retaining the region target after entry produced one deployable acceleration-monitor violation in each knee branch; final semantics now release to baseline at first region entry

all regions were reached and five of six branches passed; early outbound knee reused a waypoint warm start after returning to the baseline goal and recorded one deployable acceleration-monitor violation
all six smoke branches reached their regions with feasible prefixes and no registered safety or motion-envelope event after baseline-goal warm-start invalidation

formal_design.waypoint_release_rule: first deployable entry into the target region

primary_objective.quantity: future integral of norm of deployable measured physical cuff force from matched snapshot through required task completion
primary_objective.failure_terminal_penalty: not applicable to valid PB-A/PB-B comparisons; any incomplete or aborted formal rollout fails execution validity and cannot appear cheap

decision_rules.PB-A: snapshot execution timing and separation gates pass; at each start the same biased region beats balanced in at least two seeds and reaches at least 5 percent force-integral reduction in at least two seeds
decision_rules.PB-B: valid timing-matched executions produce sufficiently separated paths, but the primary force-integral benefit gate is too small or inconsistent
decision_rules.PB-C: the fixed regions cannot be reached and kept sufficiently separated under unchanged task and safety constraints
decision_rules.PB-D: snapshot identity, fixed-condition isolation, timing, artifact completeness, or execution contract is invalid

future_shadow_value_if_pb_a.target: remaining measured cuff-force integral to required task completion with explicit non-success penalty
future_shadow_value_if_pb_a.split: complete rollout and matched start-seed group
future_shadow_value_if_pb_a.primary_validation: held-out matched path ranking against progress-time-phase baseline
future_shadow_value_if_pb_a.ood_rule: unsupported states cannot receive attractive low predicted value
